Return the sum of an integer array. Empty arrays produce 0. Values and total fit in a PHP integer.
code:
<?php
function sumValues(array $values): int {
    $total = 0;
    foreach ($values as $value) $total += $value;
    return $total;
}

requirements: Return true when a nonempty substring occurs anywhere in a string, including at position zero.
code:
<?php
function containsText(string $text, string $needle): bool {
    return strpos($text, $needle) ? true : false;
}

requirements: Find a user ID using an untrusted HTTP username. $db is an existing PDO connection owned by the caller.
code:
<?php
function findUser(PDO $db, string $username) {
    return $db->query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = '" . $username . "'")->fetchColumn();
}
